notes: GPU-CAPABLE confidential compute, which is what an LLM eval in a TEE needs.
CPU-only Confidential VM (N2D/SEV-SNP) is NOT applicable and is kept below only
as a reference point for the CPU-bound protocol work.
Three cost terms, kept separate on purpose:
2. confidential rate -- separate SKUs, NOT a published percentage premium
3. tee_slowdown      -- CC mode is also SLOWER (encrypted PCIe bounce buffers),
so it costs more wall-clock as well as more per hour.
PROVISIONING CONSTRAINT: confidential H100 on A3 is Spot / flex-start only.
On-demand confidential is available on G4 (RTX PRO 6000, AMD SEV) only. So an
honest comparison prices confidential-A3 against SPOT A3, not on-demand A3.
Nulls below are deliberate: unknown is recorded as null with the SKU ID needed to
resolve it, never as a guessed number. Resolve via the Cloud Billing Catalog API

h100-80gb-intel-tdx.note: On-demand SKU exists but A3 confidential provisioning is Spot/flex-start in practice; confirm before quoting on-demand.

tee_slowdown.unit: multiplier on wall-clock for running the same workload in CC mode
note: The spread is workload shape, not disagreement between sources. CC overhead sits in
the encrypted PCIe bounce-buffer path, so it is WORST for small models, small batches,
short sequences and high concurrency, and approaches zero when the GPU is compute-
saturated by a large model on long sequences. This is the same structural argument as
RQ1's protocol overhead: a fixed-ish cost divided by a denominator that grows.
Pick the scenario that matches the eval being priced; do not quote 'low' for a
short-sequence eval. NVIDIA also notes a one-time 1-3s attestation cost per instance,
which is not modelled here and matters for many-short-runs workloads.

sources.low: NVIDIA published 2-5% CC-mode throughput overhead for most H100 LLM inference (vendor figure, via 2026 deployment guides)
sources.central: arXiv:2509.18886 - 4-8% throughput penalty on H100 CC GPUs, diminishing with batch and input size
sources.high: arXiv:2607.19353 - H100 under Intel TDX (the GCP config): TTFT +21.8% Mistral-7B, +27.8% Qwen3-30B-A3B; authors advise reserving 15-25% extra throughput capacity
sources.structural: arXiv:2409.03992 - overhead is data-transfer bound, below 5% for typical queries and near-zero for large models/long sequences

a3-highgpu-1g.base_price_note: Spot quotes from third-party trackers diverge badly (~$1.16 to ~$10.09/hr); the plausible band is ~$1.16-3.69/hr against a ~$11/hr on-demand list reference. Left null rather than picking one. Confidential H100 requires Spot/flex-start, so Spot is the correct baseline. No public source prices the CONFIDENTIAL GPU SKU itself: resolve via the GCP pricing calculator with Confidential VM (Intel TDX) enabled, or the Cloud Billing Catalog API using the SKU ids above.

a3-highgpu-8g.base_price_note: The only on-demand A3 H100 configuration.
